kebab_example: aliyun facebody batch-add-faces --db-name default --entity-id U1 --faces ImageURL=https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/imgsearch/demo/1.png ExtraData=王小二 --api-version 2019-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchAddFaces

parameters.help_en: The database name. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称。支持小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度1~64
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The entity ID, which uniquely identifies a user, such as a user ID or employee ID. Each entity can contain multiple face images. The ID can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 实体ID，用来标识用户的唯一性，如用户ID、员工ID等。每个实体可包含多张人脸图片。支持大小写字母、数字、下划线的组合，长度为1~64
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The intra-entity similarity threshold. The new face image is compared with existing faces within the specified EntityId. If the similarity score is less than this threshold, the new face image is considered too different from existing faces, and the addition fails. If no faces exist within the EntityId, the addition succeeds. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that intra-entity similarity check is not performed. For reference values, see the Thresholds field in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 类内相似度阈值。将新增人脸图片与EntityId内已有人脸进行相似比对，小于该阈值则表示与其他人脸图片差异较大，添加失败.；若EntityId内没有人脸存在，则添加成功。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做类内相似度判断逻辑。参考值见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html接口的返回结果字段**Thresholds**
parameters.name: similarity_score_threshold_in_entity

parameters.help_en:
The inter-entity similarity threshold. The new face image is compared with existing faces in all other EntityId entries. If the similarity score is greater than or equal to this threshold, a similar face exists in another EntityId, indicating a duplicate, and the addition fails. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that inter-entity similarity check is not performed. For reference values, see the Thresholds field in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html operation.

The inter-entity similarity threshold check applies only to the first face image uploaded for each EntityId
parameters.help_zh:
类间相似度阈值。将新增人脸图片与其他所有EntityId内已有人脸进行相似比对，大于等于该阈值则表示其他EntityId内存在相似人脸，出现重复，添加失败。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做类间相似度判断逻辑。参考值见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151891.html接口的返回结果字段**Thresholds**。

类间相似度阈值检查仅适用于每个EntityId下首次上传的第一张人脸图片
parameters.name: similarity_score_threshold_between_entity

fields.help_en: The custom information. The value can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters. Maximum length: 512 characters
fields.help_zh: 自定义信息。支持字母、数字、标点符号和汉字。不超过512个字符
fields.name: extra_data

fields.help_en: The URL of the face image. The face must be a frontal, unoccluded, single-person face. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the China (Shanghai) region, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html. Maximum URL length: 1024 characters
fields.help_zh: 人脸图像URL地址。人脸必须是正面无遮挡单人人脸。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。URL长度不超过1024个字符
fields.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The quality score threshold. The new face image is analyzed for quality. If the quality score is less than this threshold, the face image does not meet quality requirements, and the addition fails. Valid values: [0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that quality score check is not performed
parameters.help_zh: 质量分阈值。对新增人脸图片进行质量分析判断，得到的质量分小于该阈值则表示新增人脸图片质量不符合要求，添加失败。取值范围[0.0,100.0]。0.0或空则表示不做质量分判断逻辑
parameters.name: quality_score_threshold

ImageURL.description_zh: 人脸图像地址，与输入的ImageUrl相同，用来标记图像记录
